item.title: Bulletin updated at 05:50 HKT 01/Jan/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong easterly airstream will continue to affect the coast of Guangdong today, while a cold front will move across the coastal areas later today. Under the influence of the associated winter monsoon, winds will strengthen from the north and temperatures will fall appreciably over the region. It will become cold and the weather will improve in the next couple of days. Dry replenishments of the monsoon are expected to influence Guangdong persistently early to midweek next week. It will be generally fine and remain rather cool in the morning over the region. The temperature difference between day and night will be rather large over inland areas.

Weather: Mainly cloudy. Dry with sunny periods during the day. Temperatures will fall appreciably at night.
Temp range: 16 - 22 C
R.H. range: 55 - 80 per Cent
PSR: Low
